items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: "Like Barnum and Bailey. Chick's like the greatest show on earth."

ctx.x: What would you tell the guys when you went in to Cab's band?
Oh, I told them, I say, "I came from the big tent." They say, "What do you mean the big tent." I say, "Like Barnum and Bailey. Chick's like the greatest show on earth." You know, like --
